title: Carbon Tax Trajectory and Cost-of-Living Protection
topic_prompt: Reaching Singapore's statutory 2050 net-zero greenhouse gas commitments requires accelerating the carbon tax trajectory, yet rapid increases risk driving up utility tariffs and grocery prices regressively for lower- and middle-income families. One participant insists on uncompromising climate urgency, while the other defends families already burdened by inflationary living costs. Deliberate to find common ground.

ballot.prompt: Based on your deliberation, select the single policy resolution that best represents your preferred path forward:

options.A: Commit to an accelerated carbon tax schedule paired with 100% ringfenced revenue recycling into progressive household Climate Vouchers (U-Save), targeted HDB energy retrofits, and green transition safety nets. (Key - Integrative Compromise)
options.B: Permanently freeze carbon tax rates at baseline nominal levels, postponing statutory decarbonization targets indefinitely to avert any utility bill increase. (Distractor 1 - Status Quo Inertia)
options.C: Impose a steep carbon tax surge immediately with zero consumer offsets or transitional rebates, maintaining that unbuffered economic pain is the sole effective driver of consumption reduction. (Distractor 2 - Technocratic Zero-Sum)
options.D: Repeal domestic carbon taxation altogether and deflect responsibility to regional neighbors and multinational cargo shipping, refusing local climate accountability. (Distractor 3 - External Scapegoating/Deflection)
